title: 3 Super Saiyan Transformations in Dragon Ball Fans Will Never See Again
content: The Saiyan Saga in Dragon Ball Z was a huge turning point, and the story hasn’t been the same ever since. It revealed Goku’s origins as a member of the proud warrior race, which explains a lot about his natural talent as a martial artist.
author: ComicBook

title: Puchimas! -Petit Idolm@ster- Manga to End on December 25
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine announced on Tuesday that Akane's Puchimas! -Petit Idolm@ster- manga will end in the magazine on December 25. Kadokawa will ship the 16th and last volume at the end of February 2027.
author: ANN

title: New Zombie Anime Sets Crunchyroll Release Date in Time for Halloween – Watch Trailer
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is right around the corner, and the new lineup is more exciting than ever with the return of Black Clover, The Apothecary Diaries , and some of the most anticipated series with sequels. The final quarter of this year also has a list of exciting new anime series lineup for this season.
author: ComicBook

title: Sekina Aoi's Asobi no Kankei Novels Get Manga Adaptation
content: The 18th issue of Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine announced on Friday that Sekina Aoi 's Asobi no Kankei novels will get a manga adaptation by Koruri in the next issue on September 25. Kurehito Misaki is credited as the character designer.
author: ANN

title: Duel Masters Play's Smartphone Game Gets Duel Masters Pure Play's Manga
content: A new manga titled Duel Masters Pure Play's , based on the Duel Masters Play's smartphone game, launched in Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic manga service on Monday. Reki Yayoi is drawing the manga.
author: ANN

title: Yuna Anisaki Launches Kōkyū Gohi no Kuroshiro na Oshigoto Manga on September 18
content: Shogakukan 's Yawaraka Spirits manga website revealed last Friday that Yuna Anisaki will launch a new manga adapting Kazuki Karasawa 's Kōkyū Gohi no Kuroshiro na Oshigoto (The Black and White Duties of the Inner Palace's Lady of Go) novel. The manga will launch on September 18.
author: ANN

title: BookWalker Expands Catalog with Mahjong Pros Publishing Titles
content: Kadokawa 's BookWalker Global store announced on Tuesday that it is partnering with Mahjong set company Mahjong Pros ' Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint to expand its catalog with the publisher's titles.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen, Kagurabachi, More Manga Rank on NYT September Bestseller List
content: The manga on this month's list include: • #7 — Gege Akutami's Jujutsu Kaisen volume 1 • #9 — Takeru Hokazono's Kagurabachi volume 8 • #15 — Mokumokuren's The Summer Hikaru Died volume 1 The first volume of Jujutsu Kaisen ranked at #7 in August.
author: ANN

title: Goodbye, Lara Anime Gets Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kinema Citrus ' Goodbye, Lara ( Sayonara Lara ) original anime announced on Tuesday that the series will get a manga adaptation by Citrus creator Saburouta on Kadokawa 's KadoComi manga platform in October.
author: ANN

title: Higurashi: When They Cry Mahjong Game Gets Remaster for Switch, PS5, PC
content: City Connection announced on Tuesday that the 2009 Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong mahjong game for the Higurashi: When They Cry franchise is getting a remaster. The Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong Remaster game will launch for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in Japan in 2027.
author: ANN
